name: Hetzner Cloud API
description: Hetzner Cloud API OpenAPI specification — compute, volumes, firewalls, load balancers, networks, DNS, SSH keys, images, ISOs
notes: OpenAPI 3.0.3 JSON (~1.2MB, v0.28.0 Nov 2025). Unofficial derivative of Hetzner's official Cloud API spec, deliberately chosen: Hetzner publishes official specs through the interactive viewer at docs.hetzner.cloud but does NOT host raw files on a public GitHub repo, so github-raw is only viable via this community repo. Maintainer consolidates components and ensures unique operation IDs for codegen; ~1.2MB vs the ~2.9MB official. MIT licensed. Exit criteria: if repo goes 90+ days without commits or diverges from the official spec, file follow-up to reassess (Jina against docs.hetzner.cloud, or hold until Hetzner publishes fetchable raw spec). GITHUB_TOKEN recommended for tree-API rate limits.

name: Hetzner Cloud Docs
description: Hetzner Cloud product documentation — servers, volumes, firewalls, apps, API getting-started, billing
notes: JS-rendered at docs.hetzner.com/cloud/ — no llms.txt, no GitHub source. Jina Reader is the only viable strategy. No incremental sync skip-fetch (Jina exposes no cache headers); content-hash dedup still prevents unnecessary writes (FA-095). Paths are curated — extend per user demand, not exhaustive. robots.txt: Allow: /. JINA_API_KEY recommended.
